checks.exercise: Scapular pull-up with small shoulder-girdle driven torso elevation
checks.equipment: Fixed overhead pull-up bar and support frame
checks.setup: 철봉을 어깨너비 정도의 오버핸드로 잡고 팔을 편 채 매달린다.
checks.hands: Closed fixed overhand grips; elbows remain at 175 degrees
checks.feet: Feet suspended throughout; no horizontal swing
checks.movement: 팔꿈치를 굽히지 않고 어깨를 귀에서 멀어지게 내려 몸통을 조금 들어 올린다. 천천히 매달린 자세로 돌아온다.

limitations: Shoulder-girdle glide approximated by clavicle translation; not anatomical scapular simulation or motion capture.
Five degrees retained elbow bend; 0.45 model-unit torso rise.
Sampled bar/body clearance, not exhaustive mesh collision certification.
